content:
Evelyn Park: Hey all, second day and hitting a weird one. I migrated from my personal Mac using Migration Assistant, and now the company Mac shows a Kandji popup that says "device enrolled to different user" and my VPN install fails with a blocked system extension. I'm locked out of corporate Slack on that device until MDM settles. Thoughts?
IT Ops Bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-5083 (assigned to device-team).
Hector Alvarez: Welcome! Migration Assistant can bring over profiles and certs which confuses enrollment. Can you paste the Kandji error text and macOS version/model?
Evelyn Park: Message: "Enrollment mismatch: user mismatch (profile-owner: maya@redwood.example)" Model MacBookPro14,3 macOS 13.4.1. I did migrate everything incl. iCloud Keychain.
Maya Singh: That "maya@" is my old machine; I used to hand back a test laptop and apparently the profile stub traveled with your restore. If the profile owner doesn't match ABM assignment Kandji will refuse.
Hector Alvarez: Two quick fixes: 1) wipe and re-provision (fastest clean), or 2) we clear the stale profile binding and force re-enroll from our console. If you want to keep some local settings, we can remove just the MDM/profile bits. Which do you prefer?
Evelyn Park: I have dotfiles and a lot of Brew packages I'd rather not recreate. Can you remove the stale profile and create a temp admin so I can finish setup and reinstall VPN?
Hector Alvarez: Sure. Can you run (in Terminal) and paste outputs: `profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo /usr/sbin/spctl --status`?
Evelyn Park: Ran them. Output: 
``nprofiles status -type enrollment
MDM enrollment: enrolled as maya@redwood.example (pending user mismatch)
$ sudo /usr/sbin/spctl --status
assessments enabled
``
Maya Singh: Yep that's the leftover profile. Evelyn, DM me your serial and I'll unbind the stale owner. Also, we need People Ops to confirm device assignment since the profile claims a different user.
People Ops Bot: Please confirm if this is company issued and which employee should be the owner.
Evelyn Park: Confirmed company issued, assigned to Evelyn Park. DM'd serial C02MNO654321 and device-id 3b2a1c.
Hector Alvarez: Done: we removed the orphaned profile binding and pushed a fresh enroll command at 2145678912. Creating a temporary admin group entry for 12h while you finish installs. Also pushed a small policy to allow the network kernel extension prompt for the VPN to proceed.
IT Ops Bot: Temp admin added (expires 12h). Policy push timestamp 2145678912.
Evelyn Park: Rebooted and Kandji enrollment completed. VPN installer now asks to allow a system extension; after approving in Security prefs it proceeded and installed. FileVault prompted; it offered to escrow the recovery key.
Maya Singh: Please escrow that key. We also updated the runbook to explicitly warn about using Migration Assistant from previously-managed devices.
Evelyn Park: Escrowed and everything looks green. Thanks for the quick triage!
